speaker: Captain Maren
text: The pressure locks groan around you. Somewhere in the drowned archive, a route chart still remembers the sky.

speaker: Commander Rex
text: The fortress still holds formation over the clouds. Its command spine is damaged, but not dead.

speaker: Clockmaker Echo
text: Every corridor here was built with intention. If a command sigil survived anywhere, it would be in this sanctum.

speaker: The Watcher
text: The rift is not a place. It is a wound. Walk carefully, and listen for what the world is trying to forget.

speaker: The Watcher
text: Memory Lane lies ahead. Beyond it waits the Gauntlet of Trials, the Throne of Origin, and the last answer Mechara can give.

speaker: Bolt Simulation
text: Challenge loop initialized. Descend, adapt, and return stronger. The dungeon does not end; it measures.

speaker: Edda
text: The Elder Drake falls, and the warding pylons hum back to life across Dragon Peak.

speaker: Commander Rex
text: Volt Specter dissipates into the cloud deck. The fortress command lanes deeper inside are open now.

speaker: Forge Core
text: The Ancient Phoenix is broken, and the Volcanic Core settles into a forgeable rhythm.

speaker: Clockmaker Echo
text: With the Clockwork Bishop defeated, the sanctum's preserved command vaults stand unguarded.

speaker: The Watcher
text: The Unmaker falls silent, and something bright remains where the breach was deepest.

speaker: The Watcher
text: Origin collapses into silence. For the first time in ages, the world feels like it might belong to the living again.

speaker: Bolt Simulation
text: Apex Predator defeated. The trial resets, but your mastery remains recorded in the ruin.
